literal: Speaking so as to make one weep, reproving wrongdoing, and making the right path known—the friendship of those who are capable of this, having examined, acquire.
translation: One should carefully examine and secure the friendship of those who are capable of speaking frankly to make one weep for one's faults, reproving wrongdoing, and guiding one to the right path.
modern: தவறு செய்யும்போது அழும்படி எடுத்துச் சொல்லி, தீமையைக் கண்டித்து, நல்வழியை அறியச் செய்ய வல்லவர்களின் நட்பை ஆராய்ந்து கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the essential qualities of a true friend who is worth seeking out. A genuine friend does not merely flatter; they have the courage to speak painful truths to correct our mistakes, even if it makes us weep. They actively reprove us when we stray into wrongdoing and guide us back to the path of virtue. The poet advises us to carefully examine and secure the friendship of such capable individuals who can act as our moral guides.
